  • B.S. in Computer Science and Technology

B.S. in Computer Science and Technology

Design the algorithms of the future

At Tec’s Computer Technologies Engineering program, you will learn to design intelligent digital solutions, develop high-impact software, apply artificial intelligence, and create technology that transforms industries, drives innovation, and improves people’s lives and the planet.

Go to Admissions
Contact Us navigate_next
keyboard_arrow_down

Your career at Tec

Program Curriculum

Campus offering the program

Can you imagine creating the next big app or inventing new technological solutions?

 

Who is this program for?

 

If you are excited about the world of computers and innovation, Computer Technologies Engineering is your ideal path.

We are looking for people with:

  • Logical and analytical thinking
  • Interest in technology and innovation
  • Ability to work in teams

How far can this program take you?

 

Graduate Profile

As a graduate of Computer Technologies Engineering, you will create software that improves daily life, drives business, and supports the country’s development. You will develop solutions using algorithms, intelligent systems, and networks, combining science, engineering, and technology.

keyboard_arrow_down keyboard_arrow_up
  • Complex problem-solving
  • Algorithm design
  • Quality software development
  • Implementation of technological infrastructure
  • Technological entrepreneurship
  • Technological adaptability
  • Collaborative work in multidisciplinary environments
  • Integration of emerging technologies
  • Development of applications using virtual and augmented reality
  • Video game programming
  • Research in new technologies
  • Software design and development
  • Consulting in computer technologies

Life in Computer Science and Technology at Tec

(Video in Spanish)

 

 

B.S. in Computer Science and Technology

This program is also offered as B.S. in Computer Science and Technology in English, allowing graduates to have a multicultural profile.

keyboard_arrow_down keyboard_arrow_up
  • It shapes global leaders capable of creating software that improves daily life, drives business, and supports the country’s development.
  • Program offered in English.
  • Extensive academic and professional opportunities abroad.
  • Projects with transnational partners.
  • Learning units with international professors and students.
  • Options for concentrations, Tec Weeks and/or Tec Semester in English.
  • Obtain a Bachelor’s certificate in addition to the Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science and Technology*

*Students graduating from the English-taught program will receive the professional degree and academic transcript for the Bachelor’s in Computer Science and Technology (in Spanish), plus a certificate issued by the Office of Academic Services for having completed the program in English (BCT).

  • Admission to the program with limited availability.*
  • At least 72 points on the TOEFL iBT, or 40 points on the EUC, or the equivalent to the B2 English level referenced by the CEFR.
  • Request admission to one of the campuses that offer the full program in English during your second semester if you began your studies at another campus.
  • Review and sign the notification letter outlining the characteristics of the English-language program.

*Please note that admission is subject to available space at the campus you are applying to.

  • Complete at least 75% of credits in English.
  • Demonstrate C1 English proficiency (CEFR) through authorized exams.
  • Meet all requirements to obtain a professional degree from Tecnológico de Monterrey.

"At Tec’s School of Engineering and Sciences, we train engineers and scientists who are passionate about applying technology, science, and innovation to transform the world. Our students develop creative solutions to today’s challenges and positively impact diverse sectors. We offer opportunities to enhance your skills, a valuable professional network, and a focus on research, leadership, and technological development. Beyond academic excellence, we foster human skills and entrepreneurship, preparing leaders capable of facing the challenges of the modern world."

Feniosky Avelhermi Pena-Mora — Dean, School of Engineering and Sciences

What makes ITC Unique at Tec

  • Professional internships and research at institutions such as MIT, Harvard, Microsoft, Meta, and Google.
  • Double-degree options with universities in the United Kingdom, France, Germany, and the United States.
  • High national and international employability in key areas such as AI, cybersecurity, and video games.
  • Ranked #80 worldwide in Computer Science & Information Systems (QS 2025).

Learn through an Integral Experience
1st & 2nd semesters

You will explore the foundations of computer science, algorithms, and data structures. From the beginning, you will participate in real challenges and develop logical thinking, leadership, and teamwork skills.

3rd to 6th semesters

You will go deeper into advanced programming, artificial intelligence, software development, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and more. You will participate in interdisciplinary projects with industry partners and choose concentrations to specialize your profile.

7th & 8th semesters

You will integrate into the professional world through internships, technological entrepreneurship projects, and applied research. You will also have global experiences and consolidate your training as an engineer capable of transforming the digital future.

Work hand in hand with:

 

Global Learning Experiences

Thanks to our partnerships with world-class universities in over 48 countries, you can study, travel, and collaborate on international experiences that prepare you to lead with a global impact. 

  • National University of Singapore (Singapur)
  • Carnegie Mellon University (Estados Unidos)
  • Chinese University of Hong Kong (Hong Kong)
  • Monash University (Australia)
